book.totem.nexus_teleport_manual.page.25:
§lPortable teleport§r
Compasses and Nexus maps start at your position, even outside arrays. Stand inside a constructed array for extra stability and material bonuses. Map destinations still require painted coverage.
book.totem.nexus_teleport_manual.page.26:
§lBackpack recovery§r
Arrival follows the backpack: preferably 2–4 blocks away, at most 6, with a short walk. Your own recovery grants Phasing: Weakness, Night Vision, Invisibility and Resistance. Pickup ends it after 3s. Combat, another teleport, invalidation, death or logout cancel it.
